notes: Both current transports are compiled from the identical frozen 585-file source snapshot with the same compiler and ggml checkout.
Both inference transports use one freshly baked zebin collection. All 48 host ABI headers and kernel names/module flags match across builds.

The first standalone queue check reused the Direct check pack in L0 and failed ABI validation because conditional test lambdas have different names. The corrected six-check stage bakes each auxiliary queue pack separately; model math remains shared. Original failure is preserved.
Compatible bake preserves unsupported variants as SPIR-V; native inference must fail if one is selected. Offline baking may load Intel UMD; Direct inference module audits exclude it.

The first two short-* trials exposed an unmatched compiled policy: L0 heat margin1.5,Direct0.5. They must not be interpreted as isolated runtime performance. The previous matched policy existed only in frozen experimental main objects.

The matched-* trials use the one-line source fix enabling the existing Orca1.5 margin for both transports. Only Direct main is rebuilt; all current libraries,math modules and the L0 executable remain unchanged.
Fixed Short28/natural76,5771actualslots,reserve1536MiB,read256/decay0.95,MTP4/step0.5/last0.5/cumulative0. This is not daily-default or auto-cache throughput.
Each of twelve independent processes discards ten warmups and retains five. Reverse order checks drift; these samples are not a confidence interval.
Archive contains frozen source,commands,logs,configs and protocols. Executables,module packs and expert profile have hashes; GGUF/weight-pack paths are recorded but not fully rehashed.
